summary:
For the published Workspace.Template 0.19.0 non-SVG Fable-game provider through SDD 2.2.0, template package bytes alone do not describe the final scaffold. Foundation initializes .fsgg/project.yml, sdd.yml, agents.yml, governance resolution, constitution and early-stage guidance, root agent guidance, work and readiness; a root sdd directory is not part of that contract. Both explicit typed selection and provider lifecycle omission select typed SDD and automatic knowledge initialization.

Build the complete applicable product inventory from the authenticated legacy selector, its exclusions and fixed name substitutions. Representative owner files or provenance existence checks cannot prove that all product bytes survived: non-skill producedPaths deliberately omit hashes. The narrow published composition transforms are a structural tool-manifest merge preserving all co-tenant JSON values, types and property presence; exact SDD prefix/product segment/knowledge ignore composition; and execute-bit promotion on each produced .sh file (mode OR 0111). Other product bytes and modes remain exact. Product skill manifests are amended only when present; the published legacy inventory contains none, so this route needs no hypothetical manifest exemption.

Qualification fixtures must model these postcomposition effects and demonstrate causal refusals for missing lifecycle files, changed un-hashed product content, wrong modes and exclusions. Complete initial-commit proof must also fit the command collector: some genuine product blobs exceed its 32 KiB stream cap. Comparing content-addressed Git blob identities derived from complete local bytes with committed tree identities and modes preserves full blob proof while emitting bounded metadata. Same-size byte corruption, missing blobs, mode mismatch and omitted tracked paths must fail controls. These are source-level verification lessons; no runtime, publication or installed receiver acceptance follows.
title: Authenticate the complete provider result after published composition
